title: Making pottery in Barcelona
text: Delightful time and meeting new people. I love taking art and craft classes when traveling. Spending the afternoon in a local space with the potters at Terra I Pell enhanced my Barcelona experience.
author: Marcy_P

title: Get Your Hands Dirty and Enjoy Every Minute
text: Puri & Victor were wonderful hosts and Puri did a great job coaching 6 of us through our first experience with making anything like this.  We left them excited to receive our finished pieces, that Puri agreed to glaze and fire for us.  What a great way to spend a morning!  In addition, Puri and Victor have beautiful things for sale that they and their students have made.  Handcrafted gold and leather jewelry and other goods, ceramics and ethereal watercolors were very tempting!
author: julie_H

title: Really fun but a bit too pricy for the experience
text:
I had a great time. I was welcomed when I arrived and it was fairly easy to find. I sat and spoke with Stephanie (another customer) the entire time. 

This is not a class/workshop style activity. You will have a person there to help you and provide instructions however you'll be doing a simple object yourself. I enjoyed everything but the activity is really overpriced.
author: Porsha_J
